dataset.title: GridInstruct v1.2

hard_boundary_benchmark.interpretation: The hard-boundary benchmark is a diagnostic stress set for tasks with high standard-split scores. It is derived from released records, masks exact scenario identifiers and numeric values, and reports task-specific lightweight baseline scores beside label-support and surface-purity diagnostics.

contract_and_provenance.definition: Schema, identifier, rule-link, task-contract, and split-relevant fields are machine-checkable; this tier does not imply independent physical replay or human judgement.

scenario_and_rule_contract.definition: The row carries both a scenario/simulation link and at least one rule-card link; released labels remain bound to the stored contract.

rule_only_contract.definition: The row carries rule evidence without a simulation-case link, as expected for operation-ticket and rule-question records.

auxiliary_decision_contract.definition: Auxiliary responses, tool plans, preference pairs, and reversible-review language are checked at record level.

auxiliary_opf_closed_loop.definition: Only OPF-tagged auxiliary rows carry executable controls, post-action replay fields, and the embedded OPF contract receipt.

native_fixed_control_replay.definition: A separately registered native-source replay of fixed controls; it does not expand to all auxiliary rows.

independent_opf_envelope.definition: Selected independent AC-OPF solves used as an envelope check.

registered_network_family_envelope.definition: Three pinned AC operating points per registered network family; coverage diagnostic, not a complete-population certificate.

core_assignment_package.definition: External human review protocol; no human judgement is present in the local snapshot.

international_assignment_package.definition: Source-grounding assignment artifact for the international probe; blank fields are excluded from metrics.

evidence_tiers.scope_statement: Record-level contract checks cover the full table. The executable-control claim is restricted to 320 OPF-tagged auxiliary rows, the fixed-control replay is restricted to its registered cases, and human-review statistics remain unavailable until external reviewers complete the assigned ledger.
